sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Setup and one time guard
sections.what: Loads the database, storage, report manifest and importer tools. It sets the solar data folder, reads the commit flag, and refuses to run if the correction file already exists.
sections.why: The error message says the correction is already committed, which suggests the guard stops the same correction being applied twice.
sections.watch_out: Deleting the correction file lets the correction run again, so the guard depends on that file staying in place.

sections.name: key
sections.title: Planning and applying quote corrections
sections.what: Works out which field quotes for the solar report should be retired and which should be added, using a unique key for each quote built from project, field, link and text. In dry-run mode it saves a plan file with a fingerprint. In commit mode it applies the changes only when the fingerprint matches the approved plan file.
sections.why: Likely reason: a saved and checked plan means the applied changes are exactly the ones that were reviewed.
sections.watch_out: The helpers resolveIdentity, reportEvidence and sourceEvidenceValues are defined outside this section, so their behavior cannot be checked here.

summary: Corrects where some solar project field values say they came from, and refuses to run a second time once the correction is already recorded. Only the opening lines are visible, so the actual correction is unclear.
purpose: Likely purpose: fix the source links on solar field values. The name and imports suggest this, but the logic that does it is not in this packet.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the message that a correction is already committed.
how: Loads the solar report manifest and the importer helpers, sets the data folder and an output file path, and checks whether the correction marker file already exists. If it does, the script stops. Whether it then writes the correction is not visible in this packet.
inputs: The solar report data folder, the manifest and importer modules, the database connection, and the commit flag.
outputs: The output path is set to a field source correction file in the solar data folder. The rest of the outputs are not visible.
risks: The only guard against a second run is the existence of the correction file, so deleting that file lets the correction run again. The imports include evidence and change log tables, which suggests database writes when committing.
debug: If it refuses to start, the message says the correction is already committed. Check whether the field source correction file exists in the solar data folder. Use the rerun importer named in the message to confirm no further changes.
